bagPolicy.summary: The Colonial Life Arena enforces a clear bag policy allowing clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutch bags no larger than 4.5" x 6.5". All bags are subject to search upon arrival.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags that do not exceed 12" x 6" x 12"
Small clutch bags no larger than 4.5" x 6.5"
prohibited: Purses larger than a clutch bag
Backpacks, cinch/drawstring bags, and fanny packs that are not clear and/or exceed the size restriction
Fireworks, firearms or weapons of any kind
Glass bottles, aluminum cans or empty bottles of any kind
Stools, folding chairs, stadium seatbacks or seats with armrests
Beach balls and other inflatable items
Face masks or ski masks (except for earloop face masks intended for health safety)
bagPolicy.note: Medically necessary items are allowed after proper inspection and tagging. Diapers and additional baby supplies may be carried in a clear bag.

parking.note: There are numerous parking options available around the Colonial Life Arena, including areas throughout USC, the City, and The Vista. Prices and payment methods are determined by lot owners and can change without notice.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Colonial Life Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Outside food and beverages are prohibited inside the Colonial Life Arena. The venue enforces a strict no re-entry policy and is a non-smoking and non-vaping facility.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: A variety of accommodations including accessible seating, visual & hearing impaired services, and wheelchair accessible areas are available.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Colonial Life Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call is located at the Prisma Health Box Office inside Colonial Life Arena. In-person at the Prisma Health Box Office: Tuesdays (9 AM - 4 PM) and Fridays (11 AM - 4 PM)

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Guest Services Center is located in the lobby near the main entrance and is open from the time doors open until the end of the event. If you have any questions at Colonial Life Arena, please speak with an usher, staff member, or visit the Guests Services Center - located in the front atrium near the main entry doors or on the main concourse behind Section 101.
